name: kps-investor-risk-brief
description: A Codex plugin that reviews AI-generated investment content for investor-protection risks, missing disclosures, source traceability, and plain-language clarity.

interface.shortDescription: Review AI investment summaries for risk disclosure, clarity, and traceability.
interface.longDescription: For Kakao Pay Securities-style AI investment content workflows: analyze a draft market or stock summary, detect misleading certainty or advice-like wording, identify missing risk factors and source gaps, and produce an investor-protection-first rewrite with a compliance-style checklist.
